title: Compliance.
officialText:
All new and existing refuse disposal systems shall be installed, altered and maintained in buildings in conformity
with the applicable provisions of the Administrative Code and the New York City Air Pollution Control Code.
SECTION FGC 608
VENTED WALL FURNACES
